import concurrent.futures
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import sysconfig
import time

ROOT=Path.cwd(); OUT=ROOT/'build/audit-unicode'; PY='/root/.local/bin/python3.13'
LLVM=str(ROOT.parent/'llvm18-recovered/usr/lib/llvm-18/bin')
ENV={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('PYSTACHY_')}
ENV.update(PATH=LLVM+':'+ENV['PATH'], PYSTACHY_LLVM=LLVM, PYSTACHY_HOME=str(ROOT), PYSTACHY_JOBS='2', PY=PY)
def save(name,value): (OUT/(name+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(value,indent=2)+'\n')
def run(name,argv,extra=None,timeout=1200):
    start=time.monotonic()
    try:
        p=subprocess.run(argv,cwd=ROOT,env=ENV|(extra or {}),text=True,errors='replace',capture_output=True,timeout=timeout)
        r=dict(command=argv,environment=extra or {},returncode=p.returncode,stdout=p.stdout,stderr=p.stderr)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as e:
        r=dict(command=argv,environment=extra or {},timeout=timeout,stdout=str(e.stdout),stderr=str(e.stderr))
    r['wall_seconds']=time.monotonic()-start; save(name+'-command' if name in ['upstream-ports','regex'] else name,r)
    print(name,r.get('returncode'),r['stdout'][-200:],r['stderr'][-180:],flush=True)
    return r

changed=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only','6d4ed3d1','HEAD','--','tests'],text=True).splitlines()
focused=sorted(set(p for p in changed if p.endswith('.py') and Path(p).is_file() and len(Path(p).parts)==2)|set(str(p) for pat in ['upstream_textwrap*.py','upstream_fnmatch.py','str_slice*.py','str_append*.py','lib_fnmatch_unicode_ranges.py','lib_re_bounded_decoding.py','lib_io_stringio*.py'] for p in Path('tests').glob(pat)))
deviations=sorted(p for p in changed if p.endswith('.py') and Path(p).is_file() and '/deviations/' in p)
ports=sorted(str(p) for pat in ['port_pylev*.py','port_wcwidth*.py','port_snowballstemmer*.py','port_pyfiglet*.py','port_text_unidecode*.py','port_humanize*.py','port_pyphen*.py'] for p in Path('tests').glob(pat))
save('selection',dict(focused=focused,deviations=deviations,ports=ports))

if sys.argv[1:] == ['references']:
    results=[]
    for file in focused+ports:
        p=Path(file)
        if p.with_suffix('.in').exists():
            raise ValueError('Reference driver needs stdin support for '+file)
        paths=p.with_suffix('.path').read_text().strip() if p.with_suffix('.path').exists() else ''
        r=run('ref-'+p.stem,[PY,file,'a1','a2'],{'PYTHONPATH':paths+':tools/rt_cpython'})
        want=p.with_suffix('.out').read_text(); err=p.with_suffix('.err')
